dialogues.speaker: Nour
dialogues.text: It's a lot easier if we don't need to deal with any danger directly.

dialogues.speaker: Nour
dialogues.text: In turn, the maintenance and upkeep of Gardemeks must be practiced every day.

dialogues.speaker: Nour
dialogues.text: As long as I keep a Gardemek in good condition, it will be able to protect others. Simple, isn't it?
